title: The human claustrum tracks uncertainty and prediction error
title_zh: 人类claustrum追踪不确定性与预测误差
abstract: Single-neuron recordings provide direct evidence that the human claustrum tracks uncertainty and prediction errors during adaptive behavior. Its responses differed from those in the anterior cingulate cortex, which raises the possibility that these regions make distinct contributions to updating beliefs and guiding behavior in ever-changing environments.
abstract_zh: 单个神经元记录提供直接证据，表明人类claustrum在自适应行为中追踪不确定性和预测误差。其反应与前扣带皮层不同，这提示这些区域可能在信念更新和指导不断变化环境下的行为中发挥不同的贡献。
